title: How long to reset caffeine tolerance

entries.query_str: how long does it take to reset caffeine tolerance. was drinking like 5 coffees a day during a deadline
entries.answer: Most withdrawal symptoms (headache, fatigue) peak in **1–2 days** and fade within **about 7–9 days** of stopping [1]. Tolerance to caffeine's alerting effects largely reverses over a similar window, roughly **1–2 weeks** of abstinence or very low intake [1][2]. Tapering (e.g., cutting one cup every 2–3 days) avoids the worst headaches. If you don't want to fully stop, dropping to 1–2 cups/day still restores much of the effect over a couple of weeks [2].
